meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面上看不懂的功能提示讲清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果软件界面里冒出提示,你想弄清它到底在说什么。
copy.tagline_en: Explain any in-app feature tip so you know what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a tip pops up in the interface and you want to know what it means.

howto.what: 当你问起某条 senpi tip 时,Claude 会先运行 senpi --list-tips、读你的 settings.json 判断你本人能遇到哪些 tip,再翻对应源码核实,给出引用具体文件路径的深入解释。
howto.when: 当你问某条 tip 是什么意思、某个被 tip 提到的功能怎么运作,或问自己能看到哪些 tip 时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 它会先查实况 tip 列表和源码再解释。

say.text: 我这边现在能看到哪些 tip?
Fable 5 拒绝后弹的那条 tip 到底做了什么?
say.note: 它会讲完整的 fallback-architect 流程。

howto.what_en: When you ask about a senpi tip, Claude runs senpi --list-tips, reads your settings.json to see which tips you personally get, verifies the feature in the source code, and explains it citing concrete file paths.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: It checks the live tip list and the code first.

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see right now?
say_en.note: It reads your settings.json and tips history.

say_en.text: What does the tip after a Fable 5 refusal do?
say_en.note: It walks the full fallback-architect pipeline.
